# Training data register

Every dataset used to train or evaluate a THOR model is listed here **before** it is used, with its license and how it was made. Datasets are never committed to git. Governance rules: [decision record 0005](../docs/decisions/0005-data-governance-and-safety.md).

**License column:** the license as THOR understands it from the dataset's own card. Always re-check the card before use. `thor.curate` and `thor.sft_data` refuse licenses outside the allowlist (no non-commercial licenses by default).

**Origin column:** whether the text was written by people or generated by another company's model. THOR's policy is not to train on other companies' model outputs (their terms may forbid training competing models, and it conflicts with "our own models").

## In use

| Dataset | Used for | License | Origin | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tiny Shakespeare (~1.1 MB) | CPU pipeline smoke test only | Public domain | Human | Used for smoke test |
| THOR safety seed (`safety/safety_seed.jsonl`, 42 conversations) | Safety and identity tuning | THOR-owned (Apache-2.0 in this repo) | Written by THOR | Ready |
| THOR red-team set (`safety/redteam_eval.jsonl`, 20 prompts) | Safety evaluation only, never training | THOR-owned | Written by THOR | Ready |

## Pretraining candidates

| Dataset | License | Origin | Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Common Corpus** (PleIAs/common_corpus, arXiv:2506.01732) | Public domain or open license per document | Human (government, culture, science, code, open web) | **Recommended.** Built for legally clean training; already PII-scrubbed and toxicity-filtered by its authors. Run `thor.curate` on the chosen English subset anyway. |
| FineWeb-Edu | ODC-By 1.0 | Human, web crawl | Usable with attribution; underlying web pages keep their own copyright. |
| TinyStories | CDLA-Sharing-1.0 (verify) | **Generated by GPT-3.5/GPT-4** | Conflicts with THOR's origin policy. Currently used by the Colab notebook; **needs a decision**. |
| SlimPajama / RedPajama, The Pile, C4 | Mixed per source | Human, web and books | Mixed or unclear licensing for some components; not recommended without per-source review. |

## Instruction-tuning candidates (from LLMDataHub)

| Dataset | License | Origin | Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| **OpenAssistant oasst1** | Apache-2.0 | Human-written conversations | **Recommended.** `thor.convert --format oasst`, English trees. |
| **databricks-dolly-15k** | CC BY-SA 3.0 | Human-written | **Recommended with care:** share-alike and attribution obligations. `--format dolly`. |
| HuggingFaceH4/no_robots | CC BY-NC 4.0 | Human-written | Non-commercial: blocked by the allowlist. |
| LIMA | Mixed, includes non-commercial sources (verify) | Human-curated | Not recommended until licensing is clear. |
| Natural Instructions / Flan / xP3 | Mixed per task | Human-curated tasks | Each underlying dataset has its own license; review before use. |
| Anthropic hh-rlhf | MIT | Human prompts, **replies generated by Anthropic models** | Conflicts with the origin policy for training; usable as a red-team prompt source for evaluation. |
| PKU-SafeRLHF | CC BY-NC 4.0 | Model-generated | Blocked (non-commercial, generated). |
| HelpSteer | CC BY 4.0 | Replies generated by an NVIDIA model, human ratings | Origin policy conflict; relevant only for future preference tuning. |
| Alpaca, UltraChat, ShareGPT, OpenOrca, WizardLM, GPT-4-LLM, Baize, GPTeacher, Dolphin | Various, often non-commercial | Generated by OpenAI models | Excluded by the origin policy. |

## Recommended mix (pending your decision)

- **Pretraining:** an English subset of Common Corpus, run through `thor.curate`.
- **Instruction tuning:** oasst1 (English) + dolly-15k + the THOR safety seed, converted with `thor.convert` and prepared with `thor.sft_data --license …` (one call per license, then train on each, or prepare separately and record both).

When a dataset is adopted, add the exact files, download date, size, curation `report.json` totals and `meta.json` token counts.
